name: agent-cycle
description: A portable agent skill kit: interview -> approval -> ticket -> TDD -> review -> handoff, with tracker adapters and context-reset handoffs.
author: Sudigital

scripts.check: npm run provenance && npm run release:check && npm run refs && node bin/agent-cycle.mjs --check --target .tmp-skills
scripts.test: npm run provenance && npm run release:check && npm run refs && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:install && npm run test:contract
scripts.test:contract: rm -rf .tmp-project && node bin/agent-cycle.mjs install --target .tmp-project --both --with-docs && node bin/agent-cycle.mjs --check --target .tmp-project --both --with-docs
scripts.test:install: rm -rf .tmp-skills && node bin/agent-cycle.mjs install --target .tmp-skills && node bin/agent-cycle.mjs --check --target .tmp-skills
